bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
git fetch --no-tags origin 5f566e5cc4c75e57d9468f893af2421f21e5afbf
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 5f566e5cc4c75e57d9468f893af2421f21e5afbf
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,tempfile,sys
old="dfecd210114b4c54b9c62fba54a81a40089c2a55";new="5f566e5cc4c75e57d9468f893af2421f21e5afbf"
p=Path("scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py")
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():raise RuntimeError("STAGED_RUNNER_MISSING")
previous=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{old}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
if p.read_bytes()!=previous:raise RuntimeError("RUNNER_STAGE_HASH_CONFLICT")
content=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{new}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
compile(content.decode(),str(p),"exec")
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".public-batch-",dir=str(p.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f:f.write(content)
 os.chmod(tmp,0o644)
 os.replace(tmp,p)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from userbot_public_video_activate_all import compose_updates
updates=compose_updates(new)
print("ALL_HISTORY_PREFLIGHT=PASS")
print("MUTATION_FILES="+",".join(path.name for path in updates))
PY
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114;then echo JOB_NAME_IN_USE;exit 77;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py --source-commit 5f566e5cc4c75e57d9468f893af2421f21e5afbf
echo ALL_CHANNELS_HISTORY_JOB=STARTED
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
